name: x_publish_text_learning
description: Trusted supervised skill for publishing a text post on X using Eve Chrome profile with visual verification and explicit approval.

steps.note: Use https://x.com/intent/post?text=<encoded text> to open composer in Eve Chrome profile.
Verify the draft text is in the composer before attempting to publish.
Detect active X composer and the bright composer Post button visually; fixed coordinates and Ctrl+Enter are forbidden.
Only mark success if composer closed and the text appears in feed/profile as a post.

notes: Created after failed live attempt on 2026-05-06. Eve must not repeat fixed-coordinate clicks.
Publishing online requires explicit Sandro approval before the final Post click.
Known bad attempts: fixed click around x=1209/y=389, Ctrl+Enter, fixed click around x=1147/y=353.
Corrected learning path: use x_publish_current_composer, which finds the active composer by text/reply-control evidence and locates the actual light Post button visually.
Successful supervised run on 2026-05-06: Eve clicked the detected composer Post button, X returned to /home, the new post appeared in the feed, and X showed the 'Your post was sent' confirmation.

Final lesson: when multiple monitors are visible, cluster OCR entries around the post text and X composer controls before looking for the button, otherwise Codex/chat text can contaminate verification.
